findings.reasoningSummary: MEDIUM deliberation chosen following R44 open gap. Source 136/input 95 unchanged, core/learner/AST/Config/initial 0.5/typed source/order/guards/controller/history/Cost unchanged. Eight frozen bijections realized by inverse vocabulary to original R35 encoder parameter across 56 grounded 8-token sources, no monkeypatch/host semantic repair. 128 base cases achieve 8/8 distinct restricted maps (0 unchanged pairs, 896 changed pairs) and 64/64 ordered code pairs per codebook. Invalid maps and collapsed coverage reject; authored encoding not learner.

Each role Program/drive input/cfg/initial and all physical refs/full scalar/controller/Cost/source proof/slot/revision/packet-only T consumer checked. 64 numeric role inputs partition into 4 exact Hamming equivalence classes d in {0,1,2,3} (max within-class spread 1.0408340855860843e-17); 40320 bijections/2580480 saved lookups/0 wrong at role stage. 384 expr settles exhaust all 6x4^3 Hamming triples (384/384 correct, 15482880 bijection-class checks with 0 wrong). 80 extremal envelope settles (16/16 feasible2, 64/64 query2) verify [min,max] boundary intervals without claiming 64^n enumeration. Full pipeline 1024 native/128 exact and 896 paired conditions/896 invariant, finite adoption=true; 100% of upper tick differences confined to role_ticks while expr/feasible/query ticks are invariant (true). Max scalar error 1.1102230246251565e-16; 21 mutations rejected (server audit stage line 236 synthetic mutation #19 KeyError('n0_start_a') from candidate source subject reproduced and verified via local saved-data replay without modifying frozen code or rerunning server).

19016 actual settles/592963 ticks/58.81725123999058s within 240s stage/600s total, worker 1/retry 0. Preparation and work stages exit 0 (19016 settles completed); audit stage exit 1 due only to synthetic mutation #19 KeyError('n0_start_a') after all trace/stage/ledger checks passed. Full source(56)/role(64)/expr(384)/envelope(80)/upper(18432) call ledger, bounded aggregate cache 128MiB/raw 128MiB/AS 512MiB each/record 128KiB/unique 1034<6000/LRU 18. Complete computed kernel+Config bytes confirm storage-only dedup; all calculations run. All phase CPU+parent seal+launcher measured=58.847772913; core/storage/source/role/transfer subset times not double added; no efficiency adoption gate or posthoc performance claim. All 1082 non-empty files + manifest directly match original manifest size/SHA (source-postcheck.json restored from adapter entropy redaction on two known .ko.md keys and verified against manifest SHA-256); 5 empty logs/ZIP not received, manifest outside own hash/upstream unknown/same-channel not attestation. Author CS review is not independent audit.
